text: (Cici is my only and best friend.)
(She's the type to be affected by grades too, but she doesn't dwell on it.)
(I can talk to other classmates, of course. We say hi when we see each other.)
(But if I can see my dearest Cici at school every day...)
(partner with her in P.E. class and line up with her without a second thought...)
(and go home with her after school...)
(and just do homework the rest of the time...)
(Life is so blissful that I have no time to think about anything else.)
Of course! Let me play Aoi Prism!
Last time I opened a music game at home, my mom told me I might as well be playing the piano.
Haha, that's totally different.
Maybe she just doesn't like seeing you play games.
My mom says I should study abroad in the future.
Julian is the founder of this school.
It wasn't easy to get you into his class.
I know. Thank you!
His teaching style is... insane.
(When Cici chants along, only her mouth moves.)
(It's more like a silent film performance.)
(Her mouth shapes are exaggerated, but her voice lacks the enthusiasm Julian expects.)
I want to drop this class!
Would your mom agree to that?
(Cici looks out the window, dejected.)
Forget about that. Summer vacation has already started!
Why are we here?
Because English will not improve by itself.
(Cici is my only and best friend.)
(She's the type to be affected by grades too, but she doesn't dwell on it.)
(It is so nice that I get to attend cram school with her this year.)
(I will not have to spend summer vacation alone.)
Julian is here.
He is pretty interesting, but his teaching style is a little... insane.
Press the up key to look at the blackboard.
Cici, the teacher called on you.
White night... uh, the sun is working overtime?
B.
Pick B.
Wen, which answer should we choose for the homework?
I chose A.
Okay, I trust you!
What are you writing?
Drawing.
I am writing anime.
(Yuanyuan's eyes lit up when she talked about something she liked.)
Your rubber stamps?
That is sculpture! It is a kind of art.
No, that should be called seal carving.
I do not get it.
What is there to observe in Y-City?
Lotus Pond, McDonald's, milk tea shops.
And Fallen Street.
Exactly! I really want fried chicken strips!
Being a botanist sounds like it would suit you.
Really. When I was little, I thought about becoming a botanist.
(I had only ever seen that job in documentaries.)
But that idea feels very far away now.
(Actually, we are allowed to like many things.)
(As long as they do not actually change our lives in the end.)
(The girl in the front row has an EXO sticker tucked inside her English book.)
Who is that?
Byun Baekhyun.
So killing a lot of plants can also be called experience.
That sounds a little scary.
Roots, rotting.
You lose points for that pun.
Julian's hairstyle makes him look like he is about to take an ID photo.
Hahahaha.
His old look was not this exaggerated.
Really?
(What I did not say was that maybe if it was not exaggerated, no one would believe in his ability.)
McDonald's suddenly became international.
(Laughing.)
(Bzzzz.)
(Bzzzz.)
(The phone sound seems to be coming from Cici.)
Sorry, everyone. I forgot to turn it off...
How did you forget to turn it off?
Uhh...
I was actually looking up the answer just now.
Then a news notification popped up. So annoying.
What news?
The meteorological station issued a yellow high-temperature warning. The temperature has already passed 39 degrees.
Come to think of it, it has not rained in a long time.
Where are you going to write about?
I am writing about H Mall.
Why?
Because I like the beanbag sofas inside the most!
What word should I use to describe the snack street?
Noisy.
That is not fallen enough.
Fallen angel! Lucifer.
Speaking of McDonald's, they have a new product.
Peach blossom flavored soft serve!
But I guess it uses the same recipe as the cherry blossom flavor.
They just changed the name and sell it in China.
Let us go eat it after class.
No, no. It is not out yet.
It starts selling next week!
Julian is actually local.
I really do not know why he came back.
It would be pretty nice to retire here.
(I will probably only stay here until I graduate from high school.)
(People with promise should leave this place once they go to college.)
(I think Cici will be the same. We will probably end up in two huge cities in China.)
(Today is just as hot. It has not rained at all in the past week.)
(Riding a bike in this weather is basically suicide, so even I chose to take the bus.)
Let us go eat ice cream today, Cici.
Ugh, I am not really sure.
Maybe you can go eat first?
But the second one is half price.
How about finding another classmate to go with you?
It is fine. Worst case, I will eat two.
But Cici looks fine.
I sometimes really envy classmates whose parents pick them up and drop them off.
Ms. Minna looks very pretty today. Did you see her?
She changed her hairstyle. She looks very energetic.
Not yet. What is it like?
Who are you going to write about?
My cousin is really annoying, but also cute.
What is cute about her?
She says I am her favorite big sister.
Besides my parents and my cousin, you are also a very important person.
(That sounds a little strange.)
It is obviously a nice thing to say, but there has to be a comparison...
Why that face?
Family is always the most important, and then it is you.
Bzzzz.
Cici's phone lights up again.
Sorry, Wenwen.
I might have to go eat after class.
Let us go eat ice cream next week!
My dad is a doctor, and my mom is a teacher.
What a standard pairing.
Standard answers can argue too.
I really want to just...
Just what?
Evaporate.
(The typhoon has not really arrived yet.)
(Outside the window, it is only very dark. It is afternoon, but the sky is as dark as night.)
(It feels a little like the end of the world.)
Cici always seems indifferent to everything.
Actually, I always feel that with her intelligence, she could get much higher scores.
But her mind does not seem to be here.
Yes, I only got into this cram school because I asked through her connections.
She hesitated before agreeing. After that, it was my mom and her mom who handled it.
It was my first time asking someone for help with something, and I felt very embarrassed.
It is already the summer after eighth grade. Once this is over, next year we will take the high school entrance exam.
I want to spend the summer relaxing one last time, but I do not dare slack off.
In the end, I do not rest properly at all. It feels like I am always in class.
They call it a week without class, but I still have other classes to make up.
(Actually, I have math every two days and English once a week.)
(There is a faint ring of water on the desk.)
(It was left there from an iced Coke before.)
It does not sound that tiring, but
a single two-hour class basically uses up half the day.
For the rest of the day, I still have to find time to finish homework, so
it feels like I am studying all the time,
endlessly.
A terrible thought flashes through my mind.
What if she does not need to think about any of this at all...
What if she already has another path...
Forget it, let us go eat.
Let us... go eat.
Isn't news always real?
It feels so artificial, like it was just invented for the exercise.
What did you do after you came back?
I was at home.
Did you not say your mom was home too?
Yeah, so I was even more at home.
Why are you suddenly checking up on me?
I am not.
(I kind of am.)
And later, I went out for a bit.
Just... to take care of something.
Let us have class first.
(That was supposed to be my line.)
(Laughs.)
Let us buy ice cream after class.
Are you buying?
Why should I?
Because you stood me up before.
So you did not go eat afterward?
I am not telling you.
Ice cream is a very temporary thing.
You feel good for a second and then it is gone.
(What's on her mind?)
Sorry, Cici. I did not expect the teacher to call me over after class last time.
I will treat you to ice cream today.
Fine, I will generously forgive you.
What did he want to talk to you about?
It is a long story.
I might have a chance to go to school in X-City.
X-City?
It is not certain, though.
My mom has not decided yet.
Did you know? Ms. Minna seems to be a university student in X-City.
How do you know?
There is a school emblem on her bag. I have seen it.
(Cici's phone vibrates.)
Sorry.
She still does not have much classroom discipline.
Why...
Wen.
Are you okay...
I am sorry. I should not have told you this right now.
It is not certain yet. I will probably still be here next year...
Let us talk after class, okay?
Cici didn't show up today.
I wonder if she’s actually busy or just making up excuses.
I shouldn't judge her like that, though.
I’ll reach out to her after the exam.
